notes.title: Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle - German Language Available
notes.content: To coincide with the German language release of Barrow Hill: The Dark Path (Der Dunkle Pfad) – The original Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle is also now available on Steam in German, with full text and audio translations. Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle starts the adventures on Barrow Hill which are continued 10 years later in The Dark Path.

notes.title: Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle finally available on Steam
notes.content:
It is the night of the Autumn Equinox, 10 years after Barrow Hill: Curse of the Ancient Circle was originally published. Fans of point-and-click adventure games will rejoice that the game is now finally released on Steam and can be added to their Steam catalogues.

We wish you a lot of thrills, re-living this adventure or playing it for the very first time.  [And don't forget - a brand new standalone sequel is now also available: Barrow Hill: The Dark Path.]

And o yes, we made the game's soundtrack a free DLC for you guys.

Enjoy !
